stem.text: Which feature of the human gas exchange system helps to maintain a steep diffusion gradient?

A.text: A large number of alveoli are present in each lung.

B.text: Alveoli walls contain elastic fibres allowing expansion.

C.text: The air brought into the alveoli has a high concentration of oxygen.

D.text: The endothelium of the capillary wall is made of flattened cells.
